title: Coram AI, which helps organizations use AI with their existing security equipment to find incidents, raised a $35M Series B, bringing its total funding to $66M (Rya Jetha/Business Insider)
summary: Rya Jetha / Business Insider: Coram AI, which helps organizations use AI with their existing security equipment to find incidents, raised a $35M Series B, bringing its total funding to $66M — Most security cameras are useful only after something has gone wrong. Coram AI wants to change that.
